mapper.sql: r.id, r.item_id, r.buyer_id, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (item_id, buyer_id, rating, content, created_at) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{buyerId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT , u.username AS buyer_username FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.buyer_id WHERE r.item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT , u.username AS buyer_username FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.buyer_id WHERE r.item_id = #{itemId} AND r.buyer_id = #{buyerId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
